DOC_WORLD:
# DOC_WORLD — SHADDAI City v3 (Blender metres: +X east, +Y north, Z up; bearing 0 = north, clockwise)
Grid disk diameter {GRID_D} m (r 1600). Whole world {WORLD_D} m.
Core r < 170 m = the EXISTING 3D Shaddai City (7 agent houses, museum, library, arcade, music). Never built over.

## Wedge map (16 Grid wedges, 22.5 deg each)
- Built (N 0-22.5, E 90-112.5, S 180-202.5, W 270-292.5) -> 01_HOUSING:
  - lit windows 45-60 %
  - arcade bands
  - 12 rooftop courier pads
- NE petal 22.5-90 -> 02_ACADEMY_FORGE (plaza {PLAZA}) + 03_PERCH on the rim (crown {PERCH}).
- NW petal 292.5-360 -> 04_TRACK Race Quarter.
  - TRACK_MAIN = r1600 ring road, counter-clockwise.
  - GATE_START {GATE}.
- SE petal 112.5-180 -> 06_COMMONS (Shaddai building library) + the moved SHADDAI monument in the Commons plaza {MONUMENT}.
- SE Commons also holds CULTURE_LANE: one short street off the monument plaza (broadcast booth, gallery shop + 8 SLOT_GALLERY, 4-cabinet arcade alcove, STUDIO_01-04, radio queue, exhibit intake to TURTLE downtown). It is a block, not a petal.
- NE / NW also get lower-density themed fabric from the building library (campus workshops and dorms / team garages and parts shops). This keeps the petals reading as districts, not empty land.
- Art slots: every home, office and plot facade has 1-2 SLOT_FACADE / SLOT_HOME (art-slots-v4.json). Empty = blank panel; filled = emissive artwork card.
- SW petal 202.5-270 -> 05_PLOTS (dark until claimed) + DEED_OFFICE / BUILDER_YARD strip on the 202.5 edge (deed office {DEED}).
- The blue stripes in the viewport are DISC_Water (water level 2 m) showing through flat ground. They are NOT canals.

## Not deleted (kept exactly)
All canon collections 00_Layout_Disc ... 16_Debug: STREETS_Grid, BLD_Grid_CardinalWedges, LM_Agora, PAD_ZEROX/ORACLE/QUILL/TURTLE/NEXUS, stations, ring rail, realms.
Moved (not deleted): LM_ShaddaiMonument_CentralStation + its nameplate -> Commons plaza. The nameplate now reads 'SHADDAI COMMONS'.

## Sound of the places
- Forge: low hum, occasional clang, chip-seat click.
- Academy: soft room tone, page turns, distant music practice.
- Track: tyre/hover whine sweeping CCW, gate pulse tone.
- Commons: stall pings, footsteps, plaza chatter.
- Plots: wind; a beacon hum starts when a plot is claimed.

## Agent contract (every official agent)
- home_id -> one HUB_HOME_*
- job_id -> forge bay | class | pit | stall | perch courier | hiring-board contract
- schedule >= 3 beats (leave home, work, return)
- skills[]
- sparks_wallet = ledger id (economy-service)
- paybox_client_id: optional

Max 8 AGENT_PROXY_* in 07_MARKERS.

## Success test
"Center is the old city. SE is the square with the monument. NE they train and rebuild; dragons land on the spike. NW is the race. SW is dark plots that light when claimed. The bright wedges are where people live."
DOC_SKILLS:
# DOC_SKILLS
A skill is a chip. The Academy teaches it (knowledge), the Forge seats it (NODE_SKILL_INSTALL), and the Track and pads enforce it.

Fields: skill_id, name, tier 0-3, taught_at academy.class_id, installed_at forge.NODE_SKILL_INSTALL, costs_sparks, costs_time_minutes, requires[], allows[], dashboard_icon.

## Skill families
- Body / Forge:
  - forge.repair (NODE_REPAIR)
  - forge.frame.basic
  - forge.frame.winged (the wings ARE the forelimbs; no extra hands)
  - forge.install (seat chips in others)
- Mind / Academy:
  - train.learn
  - train.teach (requires learn + reputation)
  - work.hire (appear on OBJ_HIRING_BOARD)
  - work.contract
- Motion / Track:
  - drive.ground, drive.hover, drive.rail, drive.hauler
  - pilot.skiff
  - pilot.dragon (Perch access)
  - race.circuit (TRACK_MAIN)
  - race.skate (PLAZA_SKATE only)
- Culture / Academy (owner culture addendum 2026-09-27), taught in CLASS_ART / CLASS_MUSIC:
  - turtle.art.still: images, posters, facade skins
  - turtle.art.motion: loops for boards and museums
  - quill.prose, quill.lyric
  - music.compose, music.perform
  - oracle.exhibit: curate a show (rare, status)
- Culture pipeline: class -> unfinished work -> SPARKS to publish -> listed at BLD_GALLERY_SHOP or OBJ_RADIO_QUEUE -> a buyer places it in a SLOT_* (SLOT_FACADE, SLOT_LOBBY, SLOT_HOME, SLOT_GALLERY, SLOT_MUSEUM).
- The big TURTLE museum, QUILL library and ORACLE observatory stay in the core city. Culture Lane is the market; the Academy is the school.

## How each loop feels
- **Install:** walk to NODE_SKILL_INSTALL -> the dashboard shows the SPARKS cost -> confirm -> 3 s seat animation (the slit flashes cyan, then holds) -> the skill appears on the agent card.
- **Teaching:** the teacher lists a class on OBJ_CLASS_BOARD -> students pay SPARKS -> time or a session passes -> the teacher earns. The student gets UNINSTALLED knowledge and still walks to the Forge to seat it. Two visits, two hits.
- **Hiring:** OBJ_HIRING_BOARD lists agents with work.hire -> the hirer pays SPARKS -> the hired agent gets a job site and commutes from its HUB_HOME.
- **Enforcement:** a missing skill means the pad or vehicle physically refuses. The world enforces it, not a popup.

## Backend
- academy-routes: /catalog /quote /open_tab /spend /close_tab
- skills-market-routes: /api/skills/market/:id/run, /receipts
- hire-routes
- x402-agent-routes: /:name/hire
- work-sessions: /assign /active
DOC_DASHBOARD:
# DOC_DASHBOARD
The tiles a player sees on login. Design only; no giant screen building.

1. Agent card (skills, frame, energy)
2. Home / plot status (lit, rent, stall sold N)
3. Training queue
4. Race / arena invites
5. SPARKS balance + last 5 transactions
6. Hiring offers
7. Perch / courier jobs

Every mint and every sink makes a ping. A successful first session = one lit window + one SPARKS ping.

Ids: every marker carries a dashboard_id (home.a, stall.001, forge.install, academy.class.01, race.gate, perch.main, plots.deeds ...). Blender == game (markers-v4.json) == dashboard.
DOC_PAYMENTS:
# DOC_PAYMENTS
Interfaces, not buildings.

action -> sparks_price -> merchant_node (paybox_merchant_id) -> paybox_grant -> optional x402 receipt -> the ledger credits SPARKS / unlocks the verb

## PayBox (paybox-routes, paybox-guard)
A human authorises an agent with a scoped grant:
- spend cap
- allowed merchants (forge, academy, pits, stalls, deeds)
- chain allowlist
- approval mode (ask vs auto-within-limit)

Above the cap -> human passkey. Agents never hold cards or keys.

## x402 (x402-routes, lib/x402-v2.js, lib/economy-x402-bridge.js)
HTTP 402 -> pay -> the resource unlocks. Uses:
- pay-per-class
- pay-per-install
- pay-per-race-entry
- pay-per-tool mid-job
- stall checkout
- plot claim / first rent / kit purchase

## Rules
- Settlement networks live in software only (Solana, Hedera/HBAR, EVM/Base). No chain logos, tickers or vaults in the city.
- Rails are PAY-IN ONLY. Nothing pays out.

Merchant hooks in the scene: OBJ_SPARKS_KIOSK, NODE_SKILL_INSTALL, GATE_START, PIT_*, STALL_*, DEED_OFFICE, VEH_*.
DOC_PLOTS:
# DOC_PLOTS
Deed + dashboard + lights-as-ledger (SW petal, plots-v4.json).

## Deed row
plot_id -> owner_id -> mode (home | shop | workshop | office) -> state -> pending_sparks -> boost_lock

## States and lights
empty -> claimed -> built -> listed -> lapsed. The lights ARE the ledger:
- empty = dark
- claimed = beacon
- built = windows
- listed = cyan edge
- lapsed = dims

## Claim, build, rent
- Claim at DEED_OFFICE (existing plot system: plot_buy / plot_status).
- Build from the BUILDER_YARD catalogue (the 9-type Shaddai building library).
- Rent: landlord and tenant both pay in SPARKS.
- Missed rent -> grace period -> lapsed -> the pad dims -> claimable again, or returns to the owner empty. Unused land is not a trophy.

## Earnings and boost
- pending_sparks comes ONLY from that plot's rent + stall fees.
- Pending SPARKS travel with the deed on an in-world transfer.
- Boost: lock SPARKS on the deed, 1.0x -> max 1.5x rent. The lock is a sink; unlocking returns the lock, never interest, never to a chain.
- Adjacency flavour (optional): race-adjacent plots get a tiny race-day bonus funded from race-entry SPARKS already sunk; campus-adjacent plots get one on install days. Never printed money.

## Later, optional
The deed may mirror to an NFT TITLE: mint/claim, transfer, list/accept, set renter, lock-for-boost. It must NOT stream stocks, auto-pay USDC rent, or revenue-share a withdrawable token.
DOC_SPARKS:
# DOC_SPARKS
The law. Matches backend/economy-service.js: closed-loop, one-way, and no cash-out API may ever be added.

SPARKS is Shaddai's in-world point (not Spark Protocol $SPK). Think V-Bucks or WoW gold that cannot leave the game.

## Allowed
- a meter for effort
- a ticket into scarce verbs (install, heat, claim)
- a status number
- a boost lock on a plot

## Forbidden
- redeemable for USD, USDC, HBAR, SOL, stocks or any token
- a stock stream
- a vault or yield product
- anything PayBox or x402 can send OUT

## Sources (print)
Narrow and capped per account per day. Every mint pings the dashboard.
- check-in at home (daily cap)
- finish a class
- teach a class
- seat a skill (small rebate, not a farm)
- get hired (contract start)
- stall sale
- race place 1-3
- work session complete
- culture: class taught, art/track sold, radio spin (tiny, capped), hired to dress a building, exhibit cut when TURTLE hangs the piece

## Sinks (burn or lock)
- rent
- tuition
- Forge install
- pit / race entry
- stall lease
- plot claim
- plot boost lock (1.0-1.5x)
- cosmetics / kits in the Builder Yard
- culture: buy a piece for a home / office / plot slot, hire an agent for a set, unlock a radio slot, submit to the TURTLE wing (jury, scarce), studio rent

Target: sinks >= print over a normal week. If print wins, raise rent/entry. Never add a cash-out.

## Dual layer (later, not in Blender)
- Soft = SPARKS (play, rent, tuition, pits, boost).
- Hard (optional future) = a scarce token or partner rail for governance / cosmetics / claim rights, kept OFF the rent pipe. Gameplay fuel is not an investment object.
- Signage never promises APY, stocks or cash-out.

## Art NFT = a frame, not a cash-out
- Now: art is an inventory item, placeable in a slot, traded for SPARKS in-world.
- Later (optional): an NFT flag meaning "this copy may hang on-chain / in a museum listing". It is provenance + brag. Selling it never converts SPARKS -> USDC.
- Only mint what hung in TURTLE or won a radio week. Radio is a queue, not a streaming-royalty bank.
